_comment: Ischgl / Samnaun. Both entries below are verified-good elevation-audit candidates, kept only to silence npm run check:elevation.

acceptedBasins.why: Runs 60/61 (Alp Trida - Samnaun Laret) plus the Skiweg Compatsch / Skiweg Laret-West cat-tracks: the valley descent off Alp Trida down to the Samnaun village floor at ~1711 m. Reviewed on the map - this really is a one-way exit. You ski it down into the village and there is no run or lift back up from the bottom; you ride the Twinliner / village lifts or take the bus, none of which is a skiable link. Nothing to add and nothing to remove, so it is signed off rather than fixed.

ignoreReversals.why: Piste 1a at the Ischgl valley station (~1375 m). The ±10 m neighbour sweep shows 8 of 17 nodes within 300 m sitting a uniform +12..+16 m above Terrarium — a systematic basin-wide DEM offset, not a per-node spike — so the candidate is merely less offset than its neighbours. The run descends monotonically (1378 1377 1376 1374 1374); our orientation is right.

Piste 20 near 2510 m. Margin is only 12 m [marginal] and the neighbour sweep is pure noise (-14, +10, -14, +10, -13 across 12 nodes, all at the 10 m threshold) with no consistent story. The 108 m segment already descends monotonically (2518 2510 2509), a normal black-run pitch. Nothing to fix.
